answer_1.quote: An autoregressive language model predicts the next token in a sequence based on the tokens that have come before it.
answer_1.outputs: The model aims to predict the next token in the sequence.

answer_2.quote: For the Counterfact dataset, we employ five evaluation metrics as defined in previous work: Efficacy (efficiency success), Generalization (paraphrase success), Specificity (neighborhood success), Fluency (generation entropy), and Consistency (reference score).
